cases.situation: Going on my honeymoon Oct 10 to Oct 26. I'm a project manager at an architecture firm. My colleague Ruth Alvarez agreed to cover my two active projects. Need an auto-reply.
cases.reply: I'm away until Monday 27 October and not reading email. For the Harbor Street and Linden School projects, Ruth Alvarez (ruth.alvarez@okadaarchitects.com) is covering. Everything else, I'll reply in the week I'm back.
cases.note: Dates in the sender's terms, one named person for the urgent route, under 60 words. The honeymoon doesn't need a mention.

cases.situation: Je suis graphiste freelance, je pars trois semaines au Japon du 3 au 24 novembre et personne ne me remplace. Je veux un message d'absence qui ne fasse pas fuir les nouveaux clients.
cases.reply: Merci pour votre message. Je suis absente du 3 au 24 novembre et je ne lis pas mes e-mails pendant cette période. Pour un client en cours dont le site ne fonctionne plus, un SMS au 06 12 34 56 78 : je le consulte une fois par semaine. Pour un nouveau projet, répondez avec deux lignes sur votre besoin et je vous propose un créneau à partir du 25 novembre. Camille
cases.note: Seule sans remplaçant : une seule voie d'urgence qu'on consulte vraiment, et le message reste une porte d'entrée commerciale.

cases.situation: 我在淘宝开了个手工皂小店，春节要关店，1月25号到2月5号。想设置一个自动回复，客人问的话能知道还能不能买。
cases.reply: 亲，小店春节休息，1月25日至2月5日暂停发货，2月6日起恢复。这期间可以正常下单，我们开工后按顺序发出；1月22日前的订单都已经寄出啦。留言我们回来后会一一回复，祝新年快乐！
cases.note: 小店客人最关心的是还能不能买、什么时候发货。日期写清楚，其他不用多说。

cases.situation: My dad passed away and I'm taking bereavement leave from Oct 1, back two weeks later. I'm an HR business partner and my colleague Tanya Brooks agreed to cover. I don't want any details in the auto-reply.
cases.reply: I'm on leave until Thursday 15 October and not reading email. For anything active, please contact Tanya Brooks (tanya.brooks@kestrelgroup.com). Messages here won't be forwarded, so do resend anything important.
cases.note: For bereavement, less detail, not more. Colleagues who need to know will hear it from your team.

cases.situation: Freelance copywriter, fully booked until mid-November. I'm getting lots of new inquiries and want an auto-reply that doesn't lose them.
cases.reply: Thanks for getting in touch. I'm fully booked until Friday 13 November, so I can't start anything new before then. If your timeline allows, reply with two lines about the project and your deadline, and I'll hold you a slot from Monday 16 November. Need someone sooner? Say so and I'll suggest a copywriter I trust. Hana
cases.note: An at-capacity auto-reply is still a sales message: the next free date and one easy way to claim it.

cases.situation: Starting parental leave Monday Oct 5, back Monday Feb 1. I'm a senior accountant at a mid-size firm and I won't read email at all. My colleague Marcus Lee covers month-end, and our AP team handles invoices.
cases.reply: Hi, I'm on parental leave until Monday 1 February and won't be reading email while I'm away. For month-end close and reporting, please contact Marcus Lee at marcus.lee@example.org. For invoices and supplier payments, email ap@example.org. Thanks, Sofia
cases.note: A long leave needs a plain 'won't be read' and two named routes. No baby details in an auto-reply.

cases.situation: 我开了一间定制西装工作室，中秋休息了5天（9月24日到28日），今天刚回来。客户王先生25号发微信问西装能不能在10月10日他婚礼前改好，昨天又发了一句“都好几天了也没人回”。
cases.reply: 王先生您好，让您等了好几天，确实着急，谢谢您耐心等我们回来。今天一到店我就先看了您的西装：袖长和腰身10月6日（周二）前能改好，您7日或8日来试穿，如果还要微调，9日前一定交到您手上，赶得上10日的婚礼。您看哪天过来方便？
cases.note: 对方等急了：先承认等得久，不为放假道歉，也不解释，直接给具体日期和下一步。

cases.situation: Friday Oct 2 is my last day as an account manager at Brightline Media. My work email stays live for 30 days after I leave. Clients should go to Keisha Moore; everything else to the general inbox. Need an auto-reply.
cases.reply: Thanks for your email. As of Friday 2 October I've left Brightline Media, and this inbox is no longer read. For client accounts, please contact Keisha Moore (keisha.moore@brightlinemedia.com). For anything else, hello@brightlinemedia.com will route you. It's been a pleasure working with you.
cases.note: Leaving for good: the date, a plain 'no longer read', and two named routes. No new contact details unless your employer is happy with that.

cases.situation: I'm a solo physiotherapist with my own small clinic. I've come down with flu and need to close Wednesday Sept 30 to Friday Oct 2. Nobody covers for me. I want a WhatsApp away message for patients.
cases.reply: Hi, the clinic is closed from Wednesday 30 September to Friday 2 October as I'm unwell, and reopens Monday 5 October. If you're booked on those days, I'll message you by Monday to rebook, so there's nothing you need to do. For new pain or an injury that can't wait, please contact your GP or call NHS 111. Sam
cases.note: Solo and sick: the dates, no symptoms, a real route for urgent cases since nobody covers, and the rebooking work taken off patients.

cases.situation: I've been called for jury duty from Monday Oct 5 to Friday Oct 16. I'm a paralegal at a small firm, Hall & Moore, and I'll be away from my desk during court hours but can check email in the evenings. Kevin Tran is covering deadlines.
cases.reply: I'm on jury duty from Monday 5 October to Friday 16 October and away from my desk during the day. I check email once each evening and will reply to anything that can't wait. For filings or court deadlines, please contact Kevin Tran at kevin.tran@hallmoore.com. Back at my desk Monday 19 October.
cases.note: Partial availability stated concretely, once each evening, instead of 'limited access', with deadlines routed to one named person.

cases.situation: I'm based in London and I'll be at a conference in Singapore from Oct 12 to 16, back at my desk Monday Oct 19. I'll check Slack once a day around 10am UK time. My teammate Priya Shah covers incidents. I want a Slack status and a short note in the team channel.
cases.reply: At a conference in Singapore 12 to 16 October, back at my desk Monday 19 October. I check Slack once a day, around 10am UK time, so expect replies then. For incidents or anything that can't wait until that check, go to Priya Shah.
cases.note: Partly available is its own promise: say exactly when you look, in the reader's time zone, and name the cover once.
